title: Build Timestamped Call Evidence Pipeline
objective: Produce privacy-safe timestamped speech evidence from the two accepted mixed-audio VODs and link it to the existing 102 review windows without strategic interpretation.
moduleGoal: Reduce uncertainty about contemporaneous speech during real review while preserving speech as observed ASR evidence rather than confirmed intent or team calls.
observableOutcome: Two local timestamped transcripts and candidate indexes, compact privacy-safe metrics, a common mixed-VOD/Craig adapter contract, and synthetic Craig overlap evidence.
metricContribution: 2/2 VOD audio streams processed; segment/word/linkage counts; bounded validation sample; zero transcript/audio/versioned speaker identity, replay access, protected access and analyst interpretation.
remainingModuleGap: ASR errors, unknown mixed speakers, lack of diarization, and inherited 9/2-second replay-video synchronization uncertainty.
hardeningDeferred: No diarization, emotion or speaker biometrics, call or strategy classification, VLM/OCR, replay parsing, candidate retuning, new frame extraction, Craig download/bot/self-hosting, cloud transcription or Task 206.

executionContract.reasoningComplexity: High: process long mixed-audio VOD ranges locally, preserve privacy, distinguish ASR and sync uncertainty, and link immutable candidate windows without semantic promotion.
executionContract.objective: Build the smallest complete timestamped call-evidence pipeline needed to resume the real review.
technicalContext: Task 204 is Work-accepted at 225f570a68c3d53ecfa17986e674fe21be7d2dc6 with the newly observed contemporaneous-call evidence blocker.
Task 198 VODs, Task 200 mappings and Task 204 windows are immutable inputs; replay bytes are unnecessary.
confirmedState: Both Task 198 VOD identities match their committed size and SHA-256 metadata.
Task 200 maps review_match_001 with 9-second uncertainty and review_match_002 with 2-second uncertainty.
branchEnvironment: Create and publish exactly one Task 205 commit.
allowedScope: Read only the two Task 198 VODs, compact Task 198/200/204 artifacts, and Task 205 local audio/transcript outputs.
Write local audio/transcripts below .local/deadem/call-evidence and eight compact privacy-safe outputs.
protectedAreas: Never open any replay or historical replay_005 through replay_008.
Never version audio, full real transcripts, real speaker names/IDs or modify accepted candidates, sync, atlas, storyboards, frames or parser packages.
expectedChanges: Mixed-VOD and Craig adapters, local faster-whisper runner, linkage emitter, schemas, tests, synthetic fixture, contract, compact outputs, report and necessary coordination/navigation updates.
acceptanceCriteria: Both authorized VODs yield timestamped local speech evidence and candidate linkage, with declared ASR and sync uncertainty.
Craig synthetic two-track overlap preserves distinct speakers and global order.
No real transcript/audio/speaker identity or semantic call interpretation is versioned.
Gate truthfully reflects ASR utility and bounded human-validation availability.
requiredEvidence: VOD identity bridges, ASR configuration/runtime, local segment/word hashes, all 102 linkage rows, Craig overlap fixture, privacy audit, bounded validation sample status, gate and post-commit attestation.
commitPolicy: Create exactly one commit named Build timestamped call evidence pipeline.
Stage only authorized compact paths, exclude every audio/transcript/media file and publish main without force.
stopConditions: Stop on invalid VOD identity, protected/replay access, candidate mutation, real transcript/audio/speaker identity staged, semantic promotion or unusable audio.
Stop in VALIDATING and do not create Task 206 or another module.
returnReportFormat: Resultado, O que passou a funcionar, Valor observável, Impacto no módulo, Limitação relevante, Próximo objetivo and Previsão operacional.

stopConditions: Never access replay bytes or historical replay_005 through replay_008.
Never version real speech text, audio, identities, media or semantic call conclusions.
Do not create Task 206; after acceptance resume the named real-review windows.
